description:
Mini car AC vent cleaning brush is the fastest way to remove dust from air vents, dashboard seams, and console crevices before it spreads through your cabin. The soft, high‑density bristles lift fine dust and pollen from tight gaps without scratching plastic, gloss trims, or screens. Keep it in your glove box and you can do a quick interior detailing touch-up in minutes—perfect before a drive, a cab pickup, or when sunlight makes every speck show.

Its compact size reaches places a cloth can’t, like vent fins, button edges, and cup-holder corners. The ergonomic handle gives steady control, so you don’t jab or rub hard. Use it dry for daily dusting or pair it with a gentle interior cleaner for deeper cleaning. If you want your car to look freshly detailed every day, this small brush is the easiest upgrade.
